# Forge 3D Exercise Demo Assets

v14.37.0 makes short looping WebM renders the primary form-demo format.

Production convention:
- `<slug>-side.webm` — required primary view.
- `<slug>-front.webm` — required secondary view before Reviewed status.
- `<slug>-poster.webp` — optional static poster.

Do not commit `.blend`, source textures, or licensed source rigs into the web deploy bundle unless their license explicitly permits redistribution. The deploy bundle should contain rendered delivery assets only.
